name: research-routes
description: Evidence-backed, route-neutral research planning, exploration, and execution with explicit Claims, Evidence, failure polarity, recovery, lifecycle, and human-controlled promotion boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Compare evidence-backed routes and explore reversibly
interface.longDescription: A co-installable research overlay for arbitrary starting points and concurrent routes that keeps Claims, Evidence, contradictions, unknowns, failure regimes, provenance, lifecycle recovery, reversible probes, and human-controlled canonical decisions distinct from implementation authorization and promotion.
defaultPrompt: Use Research Routes to build a route-neutral terrain map before choosing a route.
Preserve Claims, Evidence polarity, contradictions, unknowns, failure regimes, and mature comparators as separate records.
Record failures, rewind proposals, lessons, reopened problems, and canonical downgrades; require HumanDecision for route authorization or promotion.
